offering_description.value: J.B. Hunt moves freight for retailers, manufacturers and other shippers through intermodal rail and truck service, dedicated fleets, freight brokerage, final-mile delivery and truckload transport. It combines company-operated fleets and equipment with capacity from railroads and third-party motor carriers.

primary_services.value: intermodal freight transportation; dedicated contract carriage; freight brokerage; final-mile delivery and installation; truckload transportation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors and other commercial shippers

end_markets.value: retail and e-commerce; manufacturing; consumer packaged goods; food and beverage; home furnishings and appliances

revenue_model.value: service fees: Intermodal, brokered and truckload freight shipments, plus final-mile delivery and installation; project or contract: Dedicated fleet capacity and operations under multiyear shipper agreements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines rail capacity, third-party trucking and its own fleet to move freight for commercial shippers; asset operator: Operates trucks, trailers, containers and chassis to serve shippers and dedicated fleet customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Intermodal transportation, dedicated fleets, freight brokerage, final-mile delivery and truckload transport

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and account teams serving shippers and dedicated fleet customers; online: Digital freight platform for shipper quotes, booking and tracking

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FMCSA rules govern motor carrier and broker operations, driver qualifications and hours of service.
